assertions.name: deuteron_not_closable_by_integer_edge_set
assertions.source: exact enumeration of {0,1}-pn edge sets for D: none within 5%.

assertions.name: he4_requires_more_than_complete_graph
assertions.source: L_required/L_complete for ⁴He ≈ 1.20 > 1: even the complete graph under-binds; pairwise-additive closure impossible.

description: Edge-set selection refutation: with the DERIVED per-bond energies (f_bond = c·z+d; pp 2.907 / pn 3.890 / nn 5.178 MeV), EXACT enumeration of every static integer edge multiset per nucleus shows NO static bond graph closes D/T/³He/⁴He jointly — D needs a sub-unit bond (0.57 of its only pn bond; halo-loose), ⁴He needs MORE than the complete graph (1.20× over 1pp+4pn+1nn; doubly-magic many-body). The physical structure is fractional occupancy / shell weighting, not an edge-set choice — pointing at the per-nucleus volume route (#2078). T (chain 0.94×) and ³He (~1.1×) are individually close; the JOINT static closure is what fails. Formalize-first refutation of the static-graph class; no fit attempted.

verdict.D_blocker: single pn bond overshoots 1.75×; only smaller integer option is 0 bonds — needs occupancy ≈ 0.57 (halo).
verdict.He4_blocker: complete graph (1pp+4pn+1nn) under-binds 1.20× — needs a positive many-body/doubly-magic term beyond all pairwise bonds.
verdict.conclusion: The bond graph is NOT a static integer graph. The remaining structure is fractional bond occupancy / shell weighting (saturation, Pauli, magic) — i.e. the per-nucleus volume / shell route (#2078), not edge choice. Refutation recorded so the static-graph direction is not re-chased.
